h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Howrah

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Howrah

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Howrah

c: Open ground is hard to find in Howrah, and most outdoor gym enquiries from the city are for a narrow courtyard, a small para park or a strip beside a society wall. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to housing societies, clubs, schools, factory compounds and municipal parks in Howrah. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,640 km away, and travel to West Bengal by road.

On a tight site, the trick is to choose machines that put two or three users on one frame. That way a small area still serves a morning crowd. Howrah is humid for much of the year and the monsoon brings heavy rain, so our frames are galvanised and the seats are roto-moulded plastic. We install through our own team or a dealer in eastern India. Measure the space you have, take a few photos, and we will fit the stations into it on a layout drawing.

items.q: Can an outdoor gym fit in a small society courtyard in Howrah?
items.a: Often, yes. Shared machines such as three-way twisters and double pendulums serve several people on one frame. Send us the measurements and we will show what fits on a layout drawing.

items.q: How much clear space does each machine need?
items.a: It depends on the machine. Swinging machines need more room than fixed ones. We mark the clear space for each station on the layout drawing before you approve the order.

items.q: Does Howrah's humidity affect the machines?
items.a: The galvanised frames resist rust in damp air, and the seats are roto-moulded plastic. Keep the bases free of standing water and check moving parts after the monsoon.
